source.book: An Intimate Note to the Sincere Seeker — Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

slides.text: What if your teacher never wanted followers?
A guru who's ahead of you can only lead you in circles.
The real one stands *behind* you, pushing you forward.
Not to be followed. To free you from needing to follow.
You've spent long enough being the *sheep*.
It's time to move like a lion
slides.cta: No one to follow. Only yourself to become.
